prompt: Convert canonical Roman numerals from I through MMMCMXCIX to integers; reject noncanonical forms.
Execute push(value), add, multiply and negate instructions on an integer stack; require exactly one final value.
Expand ${NAME} using a supplied string mapping, leave other text unchanged, and reject missing names.
Return lexicographically sorted unique words beginning with a prefix from a supplied word collection.
Compute valid 2D convolution of rectangular numeric matrices with a flipped kernel; reject oversized kernels.
Decode one canonical bencode integer byte string; reject leading zero, negative zero and trailing data.
Return sorted connected components of an undirected integer-node graph, including isolated nodes.
Find positional ? SQL placeholders outside single-quoted literals, where doubled single quotes escape a quote.
Reduce a numerator/denominator pair to coprime integers with positive denominator; reject zero denominator.
Pack a list of booleans into bytes most-significant-bit first, padding the final byte with zero bits.
Encode a nonnegative integer in lowercase base 36, with zero encoded as 0.
Return the even parity bit (0 or 1) for each byte of a bytes object.
Compute shortest four-neighbor path length between cells in a blocked rectangular grid; return None when unreachable.
Evaluate coefficients in descending-power order at x using Horner arithmetic.
Return the sum of byte values modulo 65536.
Linearly interpolate a list at real positions within its index range; reject out-of-range positions.
Return a copy of a rectangular integer grid after four-neighbor flood filling from one cell with a replacement.
Return Levenshtein edit distance between two strings with unit insertion, deletion and substitution costs.
Merge sorted numeric iterables lazily into one sorted list retaining duplicates.
Select k stream elements by reservoir sampling with supplied seed, reject negative k, and return source order.
Expand a minute field containing comma-separated literals and inclusive ranges into sorted unique values 0..59.
Convert a canonical hyphenated lowercase UUID string to its 16 bytes and reject malformed layout.
Extract a lowercased domain from an address with exactly one @ and nonempty local/domain parts.
Return the longest valid UTF-8 prefix of bytes truncated at a maximum byte count; reject invalid complete input.
Resolve a JSON Pointer with ~0/~1 escapes through dictionaries and lists, raising on missing paths.
Parse one simple INI section with key=value lines, blank lines and # comments; reject duplicate keys.
Parse #RRGGBB into three integers; accept either hex case and reject all other shapes.
Determine whether a nonnegative integer is a perfect square without floating-point arithmetic.
Return ascending prime factors of an integer >=2 with multiplicity; reject smaller inputs.
Return maximal value for 0/1 items with positive integer weights and nonnegative values at an integer capacity.
Return the zero-based lexicographic rank of a permutation of distinct integers.
Return coordinate tuples for a rectangular grid in alternating left-to-right/right-to-left row order.
